# GitHub Copilot instructions

This repo is a **Home Assistant custom integration** (`custom_components/dimplex/`).

Follow `CLAUDE.md` — the full agent guide (architecture, commands, conventions,
workflow, skills) — and `CONTRIBUTING.md` for the contribution process. PR titles
must be Conventional Commits and PR bodies must follow
`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`; both are linted in CI.
